title: Anthropic's IPO outlines an unusual succession plan: confidential, ranked lists of up to ten successors per founder, subject to approval from five cofounders (Anna Tong/Forbes)
summary: Anna Tong / Forbes: Anthropic's IPO outlines an unusual succession plan: confidential, ranked lists of up to ten successors per founder, subject to approval from five cofounders — Anthropic's IPO includes a private line of succession: confidential lists of would-be heirs to its founders' voting power, chosen by the founders and approved by one another.
